items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: we only had three sax, so Teddy joined the band

ctx.x: Teddy MacRae, was playing the pit band when we was playing at the Lafayette, and Teddy wanted to join the band, so he did. We didn't have no fourth part, you know, saxophone, we only had three sax, so Teddy joined the band, and just took him a job and bought him a uniform and everything. He said, 'I like this band.' It was a good band. And so we went on back to Buffalo, and we come back in one by one, and Stuff kept this band going pretty good around there, you know. And as big as it was. And here comes Lil…
